style.camera: 2.5D isometric action game, fixed 3/4 top-down orthographic camera, pitch 50 degrees, yaw 45 degrees
style.render: low-poly silhouette with crisp pixel-art texture, clean 1px dark outline, no anti-aliasing
style.proportions: 1.8m heroic proportions, readable at 78px tall, feet pivot
style.palette: limited 32-color palette: dark navy #0B1020, ground #1B263B, friendly cyan #63D6FF, warm gold #F2C14E, danger red #FF6B6B, skin #F2C6A0, steel #DCE6F2
style.background: transparent background, game-ready asset, consistent scale
style.negative: photorealistic, 3D render, smooth gradient, anti-aliasing, blurry, motion blur, noisy dithering, inconsistent palette, inconsistent proportions, extra limbs, extra fingers, broken weapon, weapon clipping, floating feet, text, logo, watermark, UI frame, perspective distortion, fisheye, copied existing game character, trademark

character.prompt: original agile sword fighter, short cyan-black hair, worn navy short coat, leather bracers, slim heroic build, sword on right hand, confident street-duelist stance, front 3/4 view, full body, transparent background, same palette as style
character.reference_rules: generate one canonical character_ref first; reuse it as style/image reference for every animation; identical outfit, weapon, palette, height and foot pivot

idle.prompt: idle breathing loop, slight shoulder rise, sword held low, feet planted, 4 frames, seamless loop

walk.prompt: walk cycle, 8 frames, screen-left to screen-right, arms counter-swing, sword steady, feet contact and passing poses, seamless loop

run.prompt: run cycle, 8 frames, forward lean, longer stride, coat tails trailing, sword trailing behind, seamless loop

light_attack.prompt: fast light slash, 5 frames, 1-frame wind-up, horizontal diagonal cut, small cyan trail, recover to stance

heavy_attack.prompt: heavy overhead chop, 7 frames, clear wind-up, big step, gold impact spark, longer recovery, readable silhouette

run_light_attack.prompt: running light slash, 5 frames, body keeps forward momentum, short horizontal cut, feet still in run stride

run_heavy_attack.prompt: running heavy strike, 7 frames, lunging diagonal cut with forward momentum, coat and sword trail, clear wind-up

jump.prompt: jump arc, 5 frames: crouch, takeoff, rising, apex, landing; sword kept clear of body; transparent background

jump_attack.prompt: air attack, 6 frames: jump rise, sword raised, downward diagonal slash at apex, landing recovery; cyan trail

guard.prompt: guard stance loop, 3 frames, sword held across body, weight back, small breathing motion

sprite_sheet.layout: one row per direction, one column per animation; 4 directions (S, E, N, W) first, later 8

texture_atlas.prompt: hand-painted pixel texture atlas for low-poly knight, flat albedo, no baked lighting, navy coat, steel armor, cyan cloth accent, 32-color palette, front/side/back regions, no text

negative_global: photorealistic, 3D render, anti-aliasing, blurry, smooth gradient, noisy dithering, extra limbs, extra fingers, broken weapon, floating feet, inconsistent palette, scale mismatch, text, logo, watermark, existing franchise character, trademark
